meta.title: API Request Signer - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Sign "method + path + timestamp" with HMAC-SHA256, outputting the signature hex and a complete Authorization request header example.
desc: Sign "method + path + timestamp" with HMAC-SHA256, outputting the signature hex and a complete Authorization request header example.
ui.101: The timestamp must be an integer number of seconds; you can click “Fill with current time”
ui.103: The Web Crypto API is not available in this environment (requires HTTPS or localhost), so the signature cannot be generated

ui.108: Signing rule: message = method + path + timestamp, Authorization header format: HMAC <timestamp>:<hex>. In-browser signing requires an HTTPS or localhost environment.
